The given operator is a second-order differential operator of the form

$$
D(y)={f}_{2}(x,y)\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}+{f}_{1}(x,y)\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+{f}_{0}(x,y)y
$$

with ${f}_{2}=y,{f}_{1}=-2xy,$ and ${f}_{0}=3y.$

To compute $D(y),$ we apply the definition of the operator $D$ to the function $y={x}^{2}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}D({x}^{2}) & ={x}^{2}\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}({x}^{2})-2x({x}^{2})\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{2})+3({x}^{2})^{2} \\  & ={x}^{2}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2x)-2x({x}^{2})\cdot 2x+3{x}^{4} \\  & ={x}^{2}\cdot 2-4{x}^{4}+3{x}^{4} \\  & =2{x}^{2}-{x}^{4} \\  & ={x}^{2}(2-{x}^{2})\end{aligned}
$$
